## Definition
A mechanism where quantum chaos emerges not from external driving or disorder, but purely from the statistical correlations embedded in the system's interaction graph. Suggests that carefully engineered correlation patterns in network topologies can induce complex, useful dynamics without explicit chaos-inducing components.
